snippet.title: Tenebris Somnia | Horror Game Awards SUMMER SHOWCASE 2025 WORLD PREMIERE TRAILER
snippet.description:
Tenebris Somnia is a survival horror adventure in the same vein as classics like Silent Hill or Resident Evil, but adapted to a retro 2D environment more typical of the N.E.S. or Famicom.

You will struggle to survive while solving puzzles and fighting horrible creatures.

Yet the secrets of the game lie within its cinematics. When you reach certain key points you will see sequences with a completely different aesthetic, made in live action with real actors and created by a professional and award winning film crew.

STEAM LINK: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2121510/Tenebris_Somnia/

#thehorrorgameawards #HorrorGamesShowcase
---
The Horror Game Awards started towards the end of 2022 as a Horror Game of the Year Award set up by two die hard horror game fans. Fourteen content creators made up that year’s jury. It was such a success that in 2023 the jury doubled in size and the awards expanded their scope.

The aim of the awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.
